svg.title: Three billing periods add to $891
svg.desc: Example, not your quote. Months 1–4: $98 times 4 equals $392. Months 5–9: $74 times 5 equals $370. Months 10–12: $43 times 3 equals $129. Total $891. Regular prices only.

g.text: One year, three different billing periods
Illustrative regular-price account · not your quote
Months 1–4 · paid workers + time users + extra states
Months 5–9 · no additional billed filing states
State billing end dates must be confirmed. Discounts and unconfirmed costs excluded.
